scripts.dev: bun run scripts/build-client.ts && bun run src/main.ts serve
scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-client.ts && bun build --compile --minify --outfile dist/session-rag src/main.ts
scripts.local-install: bun run build && cp dist/session-rag ~/.local/bin/session-rag.new && chmod 755 ~/.local/bin/session-rag.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/session-rag.new ~/.local/bin/session-rag
